highlights: Built an e-commerce bookstore in ASP.NET Core 8 MVC using the Repository Pattern and Unit of Work over EF Core 8 and SQL Server, enforcing anti-CSRF validation and claim-based BOLA/IDOR authorization guards.
Integrated Stripe Hosted Checkout with cryptographic webhook signature validation, coupling digital order fulfillment with AWSSDK.S3 Backblaze B2 cloud storage for high-resolution book media.

Implemented ASP.NET Core Identity with 5 failed login attempt lockouts and Google/Facebook OAuth integration, pairing an interactive customer storefront with Bootstrap 5.3, DataTables AJAX, and SweetAlert2 modals.

caseStudy.problem: Traditional MVC e-commerce applications often suffer from tight controller-database coupling, local disk media bloat, and insecure order state transitions during third-party checkout redirects.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered a modular ASP.NET Core 8 MVC bookstore utilizing a generic Repository and Unit of Work data layer, Backblaze B2 S3 cloud storage for book covers, and verified Stripe webhooks for order fulfillment.
architectureDecisions: ADR-01: Separated solution into QuickCart.Web, QuickCart.DataAccess, QuickCart.Models, QuickCart.Services, and QuickCart.Utility with a generic Repository and Unit of Work pattern.
ADR-02: Integrated AWSSDK.S3 4.0 with Backblaze B2 cloud buckets to store and serve book cover assets outside the web server filesystem.
ADR-03: Hardened ASP.NET Core Identity with 5-attempt account lockouts, Google/Facebook OAuth2 providers, anti-CSRF tokens, and BOLA/IDOR ownership checks.

backendHighlights: N-Tier architecture decoupling Web controllers from EF Core 8 persistence via generic IRepository<T> and IUnitOfWork abstractions.

Interactive admin management tables powered by DataTables AJAX for instant server-side searching, sorting, and pagination.
Asynchronous confirmation dialogs and toast notifications using SweetAlert2 and Toastr.
Session-backed shopping cart with real-time item badge updates across customer views.
securityAndCloudHighlights: ASP.NET Core Identity configured with 5 failed login attempt lockouts and external OAuth2 sign-in via Google and Facebook.
Strict claim-based BOLA/IDOR authorization checks verifying user ownership on shopping cart and order detail routes.
Anti-CSRF [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] enforcement across all state-changing POST actions.
xUnit automated test suite verifying controller and service behaviors.

highlights: Architected a multi-tier perfume formulation and wholesale inventory platform in .NET 9 across six Clean Architecture projects, modeling complex product hierarchies with EF Core Table-per-Hierarchy (TPH) inheritance.

Engineered formulation cost calculation algorithms handling multi-ingredient perfume recipes, tiered wholesale volume discounts, and dynamic bottle packaging with System.Linq.Dynamic.Core server-side evaluation.

Built an Angular 21 SPA utilizing Signals-based AuthStore and Tailwind CSS v4, engineering interactive SVG radar chart scent visualizers and real-time recipe costing calculators with zero egress fees Backblaze B2 media storage.

caseStudy.problem: Perfume manufacturers and wholesale distributors manage volatile raw essential oil prices, complex multi-ingredient dilution ratios, bottle packaging costs, and B2B price tiers that spreadsheets cannot calculate reliably.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered a .NET 9 Clean Architecture backend with EF Core 9 TPH inheritance and dynamic recipe costing algorithms, paired with an Angular 21 Signals SPA featuring interactive SVG olfactory radar charts and live formulation calculators.
architectureDecisions: ADR-01: Modeled raw Oils, Ingredients, BottleDesigns, ProductSizes, and FinalProducts in EF Core 9 using Table-per-Hierarchy (TPH) inheritance and System.Linq.Dynamic.Core dynamic filtering.

ADR-02: Built an Angular 21 standalone frontend using Signals-based AuthStore and custom mathematical SVG polygon projections to render 6-axis scent profile radar charts without heavy charting libraries.
ADR-03: Integrated AWSSDK.S3 with Backblaze B2 cloud object storage to host high-resolution bottle and fragrance media with zero egress fees.

Role-based route guards and HTTP token interceptors managing wholesale B2B vs. administrative workflows.
